items.title: Smallholder Farmers Face ‘Polycrisis’ from El Niño, Unreliable Irrigation and Rising Costs
items.summary: Cambodian farmers who lost crops to drought this summer and then to floods that damaged roughly 5% of the country’s wet-season rice now face a prolonged El Niño expected to stretch the dry season into next year.

items.title: US Detains Exiled Cambodian Activist Monk, Says He Overstayed Visa Updated
items.summary: Prominent Cambodian activist monk But Buntenh was arrested by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement at a Louisiana airport last week, the Department of Homeland Security said, accusing him of overstaying his visa.

items.title: France Seeks Two Cambodians in Lim Kimya Killing With Interpol Red Notices
items.summary: Interpol has published red notices at France’s request for two Cambodian men wanted in the killing of former Cambodian opposition lawmaker Lim Kimya, who was shot dead in Bangkok nearly two years ago.

items.title: Cambodia, France Sign 29 Deals Spanning Energy, Defense
items.summary: Cambodia and France signed 29 agreements during French President Emmanuel Macron’s visit to the country this week, including deals to expand military and economic cooperation.
